_comment: Loud, documented staleness waivers for the provenance gate (evals/provenance.py). Every entry needs a non-empty reason; remove an entry the moment the artifact is regenerated. Current entries: the 2026-08-10 hta.org domain move plus two sixth-agency additions on 2026-08-13, Elk Grove (e-tran) and Fresno Area Express (FAX), all pending the next promoted eval run.

acknowledged.reason: hta-fares source domain moved (humboldttransit.org now 404s; site relocated to hta.org). The 2026-08-10 refetch rebound corpus_version 0938fff0539a to 35ec70d6359d; the refresh report confirmed no policy-text change, only the source URL and fetch metadata. Superseded 2026-08-13 by two larger corpus changes that landed the same day: Elk Grove Transit Services (e-tran) added as the sixth agency (etran-fares, etran-senior-pass), and Fresno Area Express (FAX) added as the seventh (fax-fares plus the corpus's first two PDFs, the reduced-fare program instructions in English and Spanish). These artifacts predate both agencies entirely, and none of e-tran's or FAX's eval cases has been scored against a live model, so the published pass counts describe neither corpus. Regenerate all three at the next promoted live eval run and remove these entries.
